newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CNT Group 1996 net returns to profit.
newsitem.headline: CNT Group 1996 net returns to profit.

text.p: The company proposed a special dividend of seven H.K. cents per share vs nil.

Net is after an exceptional gain of HK$56.06 million on deemed disposal of investment in a subsidiary upon its public offering shares and gain of HK$4.33 million on interest income derived from share application monies received during the initial public offering period of a subsidiary, loss of HK$1.71 million on winding up of an associated company, loss of HK$2.23 million on provision for permanent diminution in value of a long-term investment, loss of HK$20.24 million on provision against long-term receivable and loss of HK$18.43 million on provision for diminution in value of properties under development.
Total dividend for year is 10 H.K. cents (including special dividend) vs 1.5 cents.
